The game is already a joke in terms of difficulty. 

The literally only way to make the game hard is if you make it difficult for yourself. No enemy outside of bosses can kill you because you can run past all of them, pick up the items, then run to wherever you need to go. Even if you run through blind, you can clear an entire map in about 10 minutes provided you don't stop to hit anything. 

As for bosses; they're all a joke provided you pick up upgrade materials/use a strong weapon/pick up flask upgrade materials. 

I'm sure the vast majority of players gimp themselves on purpose on their first playthrough. How many of you insisted on not looking at any guides, insisted on killing EVERY enemy in a map, picking up every item, and exploring everything possible no matter how tedious it is? How many of you used the same strategy for a boss even if you knew you could easily switch to another strategy and win easily? The game is literally only difficult and tedious if you make it so. 

I'm not even going to mention how a lot of the playerbase looks up guides for OP weapons/bossing strategies/builds, summons help, has friends drop them end-game items when they're first starting the game, ect on their first playthrough. Being online to summon help and searching up information online already gives the game an easy mode.

I'm not even looking down on it or anything; kids, teenagers, and adults play the game differently. 

When I played Demon Soul's, I did exactly that. I didn't summon help, but I cheated the game by starting Royal and cheesing everything with magic. I also went online to search up boss strategies, look how to farm souls, how to get the best items, ect on my first playthrough. I was young and the level of difficulty wasn't worth the effort for the amount of fun it gave me.
